title: Notification regarding Full Court reference on the demise of Moirangthem Jhalajit singh, Advocate at 11:15 AM on 23-07-2026.

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 22nd July, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that the bell will ring at 11:15 a.m. on 23-07-2026 (Thursday) in view of the
Full Court reference on the demise of Moirangthem Jhalajit Singh, Advocate.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ 1 5 ql qF tED I L' Imphal, the 22nd July, 2026
Copy to:
1.
2.

The P.S. to Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh, Judge, High Court of Manipur.

5. The Chairman, Bar Council of Manipur.
6. The Registrar General, High Court of Manipur.
7. The Registrar (Vigilance)/(Translation Wing)/(Admn.), High Court of Manipur.

HZ.
REGISTRAg (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
